steps.title: Saving and investing do different jobs
steps.body: Saving and investing do different jobs. Savings pay for plans and surprises in the next months, like a broken washing machine. This money is your [[emergency-fund]]. Investments are for money you won't need for years. Their value goes up and down, so time matters. The time until you need the money is your [[time-horizon]].

steps.prompt: When will you need this money? Swipe each goal to the left or to the right.

items.text: Rent if you lose your job
A new laptop if yours breaks

steps.explanation: If you need money soon, it has no time to recover after prices fall. Money you need in 10 years or later has a long [[time-horizon]].

steps.prompt: True or false: the money for next month's rent can wait out a fall in prices.
steps.explanation: False. Prices can stay low for years, but the rent is due next month. Only money that can wait for years can sit through a fall. That is money with a long [[time-horizon]].

steps.prompt: Your investments are down 20% this month. Then your car breaks down. What happens if the money for the repair is in your investments?
options: You must sell them at a low price to pay for the repair
The bank pays you what they were worth before
Nothing, because losses only count at the end of the year
steps.explanation: When you sell, you get today's price. Money for repairs is the job of an [[emergency-fund]] in your savings account. Then your investments can wait until prices recover.

steps.title: How long your savings last
steps.body: You have **{savingsBalance}** in your savings account and **{depotTotal}** in your investment account. Each month, **{monthlyInvesting}** goes into a savings plan. You spend about **{monthlySpending}** a month. Your savings could pay for about **{bufferMonths}** months of costs.

steps.title: Your decision
steps.body: Your savings could pay for about **{bufferMonths}** months of costs today. How many months of costs do you want to always keep in your savings account? You choose the number.

rule.label: Months of costs to keep in savings
